# go2rtc VideoRTC

`video-rtc.js` is the unmodified browser player from AlexxIT/go2rtc **v1.9.15**, MIT licensed. Copyright and license are preserved in `LICENSE`.

Source: https://github.com/AlexxIT/go2rtc/tree/v1.9.15/www

The optional gateway is installed separately on the hall computer, bound to loopback only. The TT camera page uses the same authenticated origin via a bounded WebSocket tunnel; gateway management APIs and RTSP addresses are not exposed.
